dtcgCompliant.description: W3C Design Token Community Group format compliance (0=not adopted, 1=adopted). Spec: https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/ (2025-10-28). Value=1 since Phase 0-A — every token uses $value/$type/$description. Phase 0-B extended DTCG coverage to fontFamily (array form) and dimension ({value,unit}) types via custom Style Dictionary transforms.

styleDictionaryVersion.description: Style Dictionary major version. v4.x added native DTCG preprocessor support and async format registration. Build pipeline: tokens.json → src/generated/{tokens.css,tokens.ts}. Phase 0-B added custom transforms zen/fontFamily/dtcg-to-css and zen/dimension/dtcg-to-css.

typographySystemCompliance.description: Phase 0-B typography foundation in place (0=absent, 1=adopted). Adopted when: (a) src/styles/fonts.css with @font-face decls for Fraunces+Inter+Caveat, (b) tailwind.config.ts fontFamily extended with display/serif/body/hand/mono, (c) docs/typography-grammar.md documents 5 sacred moments + anti-patterns, (d) tokens.json has typography category (family+scale+weight+leading+tracking). Future phases will ratchet up by adding component adoption metric.

fontFaceCount.description: Self-hosted variable font families shipped via @fontsource-variable (OFL-1.1). Phase 0-B: Fraunces (display/serif), Inter (body/sans), Caveat (hand). 16 @font-face declarations total (4 Fraunces Latin+LatinExt × normal+italic; 8 Inter Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal+italic; 4 Caveat Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal only). Each increment here indicates a new font added — locale-specific (ja/ar/he) will raise this in a future phase.

Phase 0-A tokens infrastructure — 1 canary OKLCH token proves DTCG→Style Dictionary v4→PostCSS OKLCH→CSS fallback chain works end-to-end. Scaffolding for Phase 0-B (typography+space) and Phase 2-B (color migration from src/index.css HSL).

Phase 0-A adopted W3C Design Token Community Group format spec (2025-10-28). Every token uses $value/$type/$description. Supports both legacy string colors and structured {colorSpace, components} objects.
Phase 0-A installed Style Dictionary v4.4.0. v4 is the first major version with native DTCG preprocessor and async format registration — required for proper OKLCH colorSpace handling.

Phase 0-B typography — added 28 real tokens: 5 fontFamily (display, body, serif, hand, mono), 9 scale dimensions (xs..5xl), 4 fontWeight (regular/medium/semibold/bold), 5 leading numbers, 5 tracking dimensions. Validates Style Dictionary DTCG fontFamily + dimension transforms end-to-end (tokens.css now has --typography-* vars resolving to quoted stacks and rem/em values).

Phase 0-B adopted typography system foundation: self-hosted @fontsource-variable packages (Fraunces + Inter + Caveat, OFL-1.1), src/styles/fonts.css with 16 @font-face declarations across Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt subsets, tailwind.config.ts fontFamily extended with display/serif/body/hand/mono, docs/typography-grammar.md documenting 5 Sacred Moments + anti-patterns. One dogfood swap in JournalEntryEditor.tsx (Outfit → font-display) validates the pipeline renders Fraunces in production build.

Phase 0-B self-hosted 3 variable font families (Fraunces display/serif, Inter body/sans, Caveat hand). Total ~112 KB woff2 assets (Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt where supported). Fraunces Latin-only in the npm package — Cyrillic text falls back to Georgia via stack, documented in typography-grammar.md §RTL & i18n safety.
